redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/schema.test.mjs tests/viewer.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Expected values to be strictly equal:; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: .venv - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own .venv and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: Added optional kind enum [graph, deployment, trust] to $defs.view in schema/archmap-model.schema.json. validate.mjs needed no code change: it interprets the schema, and I confirmed kind=trust validates and kind=bogus yields a schema finding at /views/0/kind. viewRole in assets/viewer/viewer.js already honoured deployment/trust kind (HEAD); fixed it to honour kind=graph too, so an explicit graph beats the name regex, and the regex stays the fallback for views without kind. Documented in docs/design.md section 5 and references/model-schema.md. Added s14 (schema) and v7 (viewer). Dependants: validate.mjs importers unaffected (no change); design.md and model-schema.md dependants still correct (additive doc line); viewer.js dependants (viewer.css, render.mjs) unaffected, only a one-token change in viewRole; schema dependants (skill-references test) pass in the full run.
outcome.descriptive: Views can carry an optional kind that the viewer uses before falling back to the name regex.

testsAdded: s14: views[].kind accepts graph|deployment|trust, rejects other values with an enum finding, and a model without kind validates
v7: viewRole uses kind on neutral-named views, kind overrides the name regex, and the regex fallback is unchanged without kind
